mapper.select: SELECT m.merchant_id, m.name, mc.merchant_category_id, mc.category_code, mc.category_name FROM merchants m INNER JOIN merchant_categories mc ON mc.merchant_category_id = m.merchant_category_id WHERE m.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND m.status = 'active'
SELECT NULL AS merchant_id, #{placeName} AS name, mc.merchant_category_id, mc.category_code, mc.category_name FROM merchant_categories mc WHERE mc.merchant_category_id = #{merchantCategoryId}

WITH RECURSIVE category_lineage AS ( SELECT category.merchant_category_id, category.parent_id FROM merchant_categories category WHERE category.merchant_category_id = COALESCE( #{merchantCategoryId}, (SELECT selected_merchant.merchant_category_id FROM merchants selected_merchant WHERE selected_merchant.merchant_id = #{merchantId}) ) UNION ALL SELECT parent.merchant_category_id, parent.parent_id FROM merchant_categories parent INNER JOIN category_lineage child ON child.parent_id = parent.merchant_category_id ) SELECT #{merchantId} AS merchant_id, #{merchantName} AS merchant_name, mc.category_code, mc.category_name, uc.user_card_id, COALESCE(cv.name, uc.card_name_from_codef) AS card_name, i.issuer_name, NULLIF(cv.image_url, '') AS card_image_url, o.offer_name, o.reward_type, r.reward_unit, r.reward_value, r.reward_basis_amount, r.transaction_min_krw, r.previous_spend_min_krw, COALESCE(ps.current_spend_amount, 0) AS previous_month_spend_krw, COALESCE(o.reference_value_krw, conversion.krw_per_unit, 1) AS krw_per_reward_unit FROM merchant_categories mc INNER JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.is_active = TRUE INNER JOIN issuers i ON i.issuer_id = uc.issuer_id INNER JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = uc.card_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions newer WHERE newer.card_id = cv.card_id AND (newer.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (newer.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND newer.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id)) ) INNER JOIN card_benefits cb ON cb.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers o ON o.benefit_id = cb.benefit_id INNER JOIN benefit_rules r ON r.offer_id = o.offer_id INNER JOIN benefit_rule_targets t ON t.rule_id = r.rule_id LEFT JOIN user_card_performance_snapshots ps ON ps.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND ps.performance_month = #{performanceMonth} LEFT JOIN reward_conversion_policies conversion ON conversion.reward_program_id = o.reward_program_id AND conversion.valid_from <= #{usageDate} AND (conversion.valid_to IS NULL OR conversion.valid_to >= #{usageDate}) WHERE mc.merchant_category_id = COALESCE( #{merchantCategoryId}, (SELECT selected_merchant.merchant_category_id FROM merchants selected_merchant WHERE selected_merchant.merchant_id = #{merchantId}) ) AND r.rule_effect = 'grant' AND r.reward_value IS NOT NULL AND o.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points', 'rebate') AND r.reward_unit IN ('percent', 'KRW', 'point', 'mile') AND t.match_mode = 'include' AND ((t.target_type = 'all_merchants') OR (t.target_type = 'merchant_category' AND t.merchant_category_id IN ( SELECT merchant_category_id FROM category_lineage ) AND (#{placeConfidence} IS NULL OR #{placeConfidence} >= t.minimum_place_confidence)) OR (t.target_type = 'merchant' AND #{merchantId} IS NOT NULL AND t.merchant_id = #{merchantId})) AND (r.valid_from IS NULL OR r.valid_from <= #{usageDate}) AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to >= #{usageDate}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM benefit_rule_targets unsafe WHERE unsafe.rule_id = r.rule_id AND unsafe.target_type NOT IN ( 'all_merchants', 'merchant_category', 'merchant' )) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM benefit_rule_targets excluded WHERE excluded.rule_id = r.rule_id AND excluded.match_mode = 'exclude' AND ((excluded.target_type = 'all_merchants') OR (excluded.target_type = 'merchant' AND #{merchantId} IS NOT NULL AND excluded.merchant_id = #{merchantId}) OR (excluded.target_type = 'merchant_category' AND excluded.merchant_category_id IN ( SELECT merchant_category_id FROM category_lineage ))) ) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM benefit_rule_schedules schedule WHERE schedule.rule_id = r.rule_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM benefit_offer_option_requirements requirement WHERE requirement.offer_id = o.offer_id) ORDER BY uc.display_order, uc.user_card_id, r.priority DESC, r.rule_id
